## Problem and change

Describe the problem, resulting behaviour and any relevant issue.

## Validation

List the commands run and results. Identify fixtures/synthetic services and checks not executed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and behaviour changes are described; relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Validation matches the change, with limitations stated.
- [ ] No credentials, production records, private identifiers or unredacted evidence are included.
- [ ] Release, deployment and security claims are supported by evidence for the stated revision/artifact.

## Risks or follow-up

Note compatibility, migration or operational consequences where applicable.
